title: MDETERM and MMULT evaluate in binary64 without x87 double-rounding and return #VALUE! on non-numeric cells
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, MDETERM runs partial-pivoted Gaussian elimination in binary64 (returning 0 when any pivot is 0 and #VALUE! for non-square matrices), and MMULT accumulates row-by-column dot products in binary64 (returning #VALUE! when left columns differ from right rows). Unlike MINVERSE, neither requires x87 double-rounding to match recorded Excel answers, and both reject empty, text, or logical matrix entries with #VALUE!.
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 in prefix_metadata (rows 150, 153) and matched across 2,071/2,071 MDETERM and 1,520/1,520 MMULT full-bank rows.
